items.question: Sino ang puwedeng mag-apply para sumali sa Dino Network?
items.answer: Malugod na tinatanggap ang sinumang aktibong nagli-livestream. Tumatanggap kami ng creators sa lahat ng level—baguhan man o established na. Layunin naming tulungan kang lumago sa pamamagitan ng gabay, subok na tips, at access sa dagdag na oportunidad na kadalasang wala sa independent creators. Nandito ang Dino Network para suportahan ka sa buong journey mo habang pinapalakas ang isang supportive na creator community.

items.question: Magkano ang gastos para sumali?
items.answer: 100% libre ang pagsali sa Dino Network—walang upfront cost o fees. Partner kami ng TikTok. Kumukuha ang TikTok ng porsyento mula sa earnings ng creator, at mula roon binabayaran nila kami ng maliit na porsyento para tulungan kang lumago at tumulong sa mga live-related issues. Hindi ka kailanman magbabayad sa amin nang direkta—focus naming suportahan ka at tulungan kang magtagumpay.

items.question: May kontrata ba o lock-in commitment?
items.answer: Walang long-term contract o lock-in. Malaya kang umalis anumang oras. Ang focus namin ay maghatid ng tunay na resulta sa pamamagitan ng suporta, growth opportunities, at valuable resources—kaya pinipili mong manatili dahil sa value, hindi dahil obligado ka.

items.question: Gaano katagal ang application process?
items.answer: Mabilis at simple lang ang application process. Kadalasan ay nare-review ang applications sa maikling panahon, at kapag approved, puwedeng magsimula agad ang onboarding. Pagkatapos mong mag-submit, hihilingin naming sumali ka sa Discord server at magbukas ng ticket para matulungan ka agad. Layunin naming mapasali ka sa Dino Network family sa lalong madaling panahon para maaga kang masuportahan at masalo kapag may live issues.

items.question: Anong klaseng support ang natatanggap ng creators?
items.answer: Nagbibigay kami ng hands-on support para tulungan kang lumago sa TikTok LIVE—kasama ang tips para mas gumanda ang streams, tumaas ang engagement, at mas dumami ang exposure. Kapag may live issues tulad ng suspensions o technical problems, nandito kami para tumulong at puwedeng makialam kung kailangan. May access ka rin sa bonus opportunities at sa Discord community namin kung saan makakakonekta ka sa ibang creators. Sa kabuuan, nandito kami para suportahan ka, gabayan ka, at tulungan kang lumago sa bawat hakbang.

whyChooseUs.title: Bakit Pinipili ng Creators ang Dino Network
whyChooseUs.p1: Ang Dino Network ay ginawa ng isang streamer na tunay na nakakaunawa sa journey ng creators. Bilang isang nag-stream din, alam ko ang challenges, pressure, at dedication na kailangan para lumago sa TikTok LIVE.
whyChooseUs.p2: Marami na akong nakitang creators na sumali sa kung anu-anong agencies at nakaranas ng mabagal na sagot, kulang na support, at mahinang gabay sa oras na pinaka-kailangan nila ng tulong. Kaya ginawa ang Dino Network — isang creator-first network na talagang may malasakit.
whyChooseUs.p3: Nakatuon kami sa account protection, tunay na engagement, at subok na LIVE growth systems—may iisang layunin: tulungan ang creators na lumago nang ligtas, kumita nang consistent, at bumuo ng pangmatagalan — magkasama.

testimonials.subtitle: Tingnan ang sinasabi ng creators tungkol sa pagiging bahagi ng network na tunay na sumusuporta sa kanila.

items.quote: Hey guys! My name is Hunter, my TikTok is @hunt2active. I stream Fortnite and I am a fairly new streamer to TikTok and have been on my journey since July. I've been a member of Dino Network for 2 months now and I have nothing but positive feedback since being a member of the best agency on the app. Dino has helped me with more than just TikTok questions, a genuine agency and person that will talk to you about anything and everything and is nothing but supportive. Dino offers so much more than anyone could ask for and joining was the best decision I've made since clicking that go live button! The community we have and the people I've met through this is incredible! I would highly recommend Dino Network to anyone new to the app or looking for an agency! DINO ON TOP

Hey guys! My name is Jonathan and my TikTok is @jona_breton. I do Banter Battles on TikTok and sometimes stream games on here, still fairly new to my streaming journey. I've been with Dino Network for a little over a month now and honestly have nothing but positive feedback. The community Dino has built is something special, any questions or concerns I've ever had, Dino has been there to answer. We get 1 on 1 support when we need it, a whole discord so we can communicate with others in the agency and so much more! I would 100 percent recommend Dino Network to anyone who's new to streaming and wants to join an amazing community! You won't regret it!

Yurrr wsg guys, this is Billy (@billyswilly_). l joined Dino Network because they're U.S.based and I saw other real creators already in the family, so I knew it was legit. After joining, I realized they're trustworthy and really focused on helping you grow. I don't regret it one bit. The community is super supportive. They give 1-on-1 help, assist with getting a stream key, and have a Discord full of guides and resources. Dino has helped me a lot, and this agency honestly stands out. From quick personal support to and even picking creators for TikTok events—no one else is doing that. It's more than an agency, it's a community. I love Dino Network and will be with them till the end. I have no regrets and 100% recommend them! Big shoutout to DINO NETWORK!
